note.default: The build takes about 5 minutes and 2 GB. Python (with pefile and capstone) and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 3 GB, 15 to 30 minutes more) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission once. Choose the CD, or a folder holding its .cue/.iso or a zip of it. An installed copy will not do: its DATA folder stayed on the CD.
